entries.title: The hook layer, and the three seconds behind it
entries.summary: Contributed by **@marcelruhf** in [#535](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/pull/535) — the whole of this section is their work, including the write-up.

entries.title: Ten skipped modules that hid 209 tests
entries.summary: Test-only; nothing user-facing moves. Every module-scope `pytest.importorskip` in the suite is now `importlib.util.find_spec`, because importorskip RAISES during import and collapses a whole file to one `1 skipped` line however many tests it holds.

entries.title: The one string that survives tool deferral
entries.summary: The MCP `initialize` response now carries an `instructions` string. It did not before: all three transports called `server.create_initialization_options()` bare, so the field went out empty and nothing anywhere said so.
